segments.description: Processes fresh meat into packaged meats products sold mainly to retail and foodservice customers in the U.S.
segments.evidence: The Packaged Meats segment consists of our U.S. operations that process fresh meat into a wide variety of packaged meats products, including bacon, sausage, hot dogs, deli and lunch meats, dry sausage products (such as pepperoni and genoa), ham products, ready-to-eat products and prepared foods (such as pre-cooked entrees, bacon and sausage).

segments.name: Fresh Pork
segments.description: Processes live hogs into primal, sub-primal and offal products for domestic retail, foodservice, industrial and export customers.
segments.evidence: The Fresh Pork segment consists of our U.S. operations that process live hogs into a wide variety of primal, sub-primal and offal products, such as bellies, butts, hams, loins, picnics and ribs.

segments.name: Hog Production
segments.description: Raises hogs on company-owned and contract farms, supplying nearly all hogs to the Fresh Pork segment, and sells feed and services.
segments.evidence: The Hog Production segment consists of our hog production operations in the U.S., which produce and raise our hogs on numerous company-owned farms and farms that are owned and operated by contract farmers.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Aggregated Mexico and Bioscience operating segments, producing fresh pork in Mexico and heparin products for the healthcare industry.
segments.evidence: We also conduct operations through two other operating segments, Mexico and Bioscience, which are aggregated and reported as "Other."

revenueModel.text: Retail, foodservice, industrial, export and healthcare customers pay the company for packaged meats, fresh pork, hogs, feed and heparin products.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of the Packaged Meats segment's products are sold to retail and foodservice customers in the U.S.
